description: This file implements methods for the CallsignTLS class, which manages thread-local storage for callsign information within the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes functions to retrieve and set the callsign associated with the current thread, conditioned on specific compile-time flags.

classes.name: CallsignTLS
classes.description: A class that manages thread-local storage for callsign information, providing methods to get and set the callsign for the current thread.

methods.name: Callsign()
methods.description: Retrieves the callsign associated with the current thread, if available, under specific compile-time conditions.

methods.name: Callsign(const TCHAR*)
methods.description: Sets the callsign for the current thread in thread-local storage, under specific compile-time conditions.
